parts:
Yes,
Better, but you have permission issues. Have you tried a regular Hadoop job?
See these lines (taken from below)
log4j:ERROR setFile(null,true) call failed.
java.io.FileNotFoundException:
/usr/local/hadoop/bin/../logs/SecurityAuth.audit (Permission denied)
...
and further below
at org.apache.hadoop.util.RunJar.main(RunJar.java:149)
log4j:ERROR Either File or DatePattern options are not set for appender [DRFAS].
Exception in thread "main" java.io.IOException: Mkdirs failed to
create /usr/local/hadoop-datastore/hadoop-jamaas
at org.apache.hadoop.util.RunJar.ensureDirectory(RunJar.java:106)
So probably some permissions issue on /usr/ocal/hadoop-datastore? I'm
not sure. Rhipe hasn't started as yet :)
Cheers
J
